example_english: I lost my wallet, but luckily someone handed it in to the police.

example_korean: 어릴 때 동생이랑 싸워서 엄마한테 많이 혼났어요.
example_german: Als Kind hat mich meine Mutter oft ausgeschimpft, weil ich mich mit meinem Bruder gestritten habe.
example_english: As a kid, I often got scolded by my mom for fighting with my brother.

example_korean: 동생은 제가 해외에서 공부하는 걸 많이 부러워해요.
example_german: Mein jüngerer Bruder beneidet mich sehr darum, dass ich im Ausland studiere.
example_english: My younger brother really envies me for studying abroad.

example_korean: 손님이 음식이 늦게 나왔다고 불만을 이야기했어요.

example_english: A customer complained that the food came out late.

example_korean: 저는 어려운 사람을 늘 돕는 할머니를 존경해요.

example_english: I respect my grandmother, who always helps people in need.

example_korean: 앞으로도 우리 우정이 변하지 않았으면 좋겠어요.
example_german: Ich hoffe, dass sich unsere Freundschaft auch in Zukunft nicht ändert.
example_english: I hope our friendship never changes.

example_english: Sujin, I'm truly grateful. Thanks to you, the move went smoothly.

example_korean: 이 약을 먹은 후부터 몸이 계속 가려워요.

example_english: Ever since I took this medicine, my body has been itching.

example_english: I didn't sleep, so I feel a bit dizzy.

example_english: I ate ramyeon right before bed last night, so my face is really puffy.

example_korean: 버스를 오래 타면 멀미가 나요.

example_english: I get carsick on long bus rides.

example_korean: 점심을 너무 빨리 먹어서 체한 것 같아요.

example_korean: 저녁을 많이 먹어서 소화가 잘 안 돼요.

example_english: I ate a lot for dinner, and it's not digesting well.

example_korean: 어제 계단에서 넘어져서 발목을 다쳤어요.

example_english: I fell on the stairs yesterday and hurt my ankle.

example_korean: 요즘 일이 많아서 몸살이 났어요.

example_english: I went to the clinic to get a flu shot.

example_korean: 열이 계속 나서 병원에서 진찰을 받았어요.

example_english: My fever wouldn't go away, so I got examined at the hospital.

example_korean: 밤에 배가 너무 아파서 응급실에 갔어요.

example_english: My stomach hurt so badly at night that I went to the emergency room.

example_korean: 신발이 너무 낡아서 새로 하나 샀어요.

example_english: My shoes were really worn out, so I bought a new pair.

example_korean: 새로 이사한 방은 작지만 깔끔해서 마음에 들어요.
